PPL or its subsidiaries file tax returns in four major tax jurisdictions. The income tax provisions for PPL Electric, LG&E and 
KU are calculated in accordance with an intercompany tax sharing agreement, which provides that taxable income be
calculated as if each domestic subsidiary filed a separate consolidated return. Based on this tax sharing agreement, PPL Electric
or its subsidiaries indirectly or directly file tax returns in two major tax jurisdictions, and LKE, LG&E and KU or their 
subsidiaries indirectly or directly file tax returns in two major tax jurisdictions. With few exceptions, at December 31, 2018,
these jurisdictions, as well as the tax years that are no longer subject to examination, were as follows.
